platform_info.name: Facebook
platform_info.description: Handles DDPs in English. These data donation flows have not been tested yet, if you find anything wrong with them report to datadonation@uu.nl and they will be fixed!

description.en: This table shows the Facebook profiles and pages you currently follow.
description.nl: Deze tabel toont de Facebook-profielen en -pagina's die je momenteel volgt.

documentation.summary: Each row represents a Facebook profile or page that the participant follows, including the name and the time they started following.

columns.Name: Name of the followed profile or page.
columns.Timestamp: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the participant started following.

title.en: The locations Facebook news is set to
title.nl: De locaties waar Facebook Nieuws op is ingesteld

description.en: This table displays the geographical locations for which your Facebook News feed is configured.
description.nl: Deze tabel toont de geografische locaties waarvoor je Facebook Nieuwsfeed is geconfigureerd.

documentation.summary: Each row represents a geographical location for which the participant's Facebook News feed is configured.

description.en: This table contains a history of the notifications you've received from Facebook.
description.nl: Deze tabel bevat een overzicht van de notificaties die je van Facebook hebt ontvangen.

documentation.summary: Each row represents a notification the participant received from Facebook, including the text, link, read status, and timestamp.

description.en: This table displays the external links you have shared on Facebook.
description.nl: Deze tabel toont de externe links die je op Facebook hebt gedeeld.

documentation.summary: Each row represents an external link the participant shared on Facebook, including the URL and date.

columns.Date: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the link was shared.

description.en: This table shows your interactions with Facebook Reels, such as videos you've watched or engaged with.
description.nl: Deze tabel toont je interacties met Facebook Reels, zoals video's die je hebt bekeken of waarmee je hebt gecommuniceerd.

documentation.summary: Each row represents a type of interaction the participant had with Facebook Reels and its associated value.

columns.Reel interaction: Type of interaction with Facebook Reels.

title.en: How many videos you watched in the last 28 days
title.nl: Hoeveel video's je de afgelopen 28 dagen hebt bekeken

description.en: This table indicates the number of videos you have watched on Facebook in the past 28 days.
description.nl: Deze tabel geeft het aantal video's aan dat je de afgelopen 28 dagen op Facebook hebt bekeken.

documentation.summary: Contains the number of videos the participant watched on Facebook in the past 28 days.

columns.Count: Number of videos watched in the last 28 days.

description.en: This table contains a record of your search queries on Facebook.
description.nl: Deze tabel bevat een overzicht van je zoekopdrachten op Facebook.

documentation.summary: Each row represents a search query the participant made on Facebook, including the search term and date.

columns.Search term: The search query entered by the participant.
columns.Date: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the search was made.

description.en: This table lists your current friends on Facebook.
description.nl: Deze tabel toont je huidige vrienden op Facebook.

documentation.summary: Contains the total number of friends the participant has on Facebook.

description.en: This table shows the interests Facebook has identified for showing you personalized ads.
description.nl: Deze tabel toont de interesses die Facebook heeft geïdentificeerd om je gepersonaliseerde advertenties te tonen.

documentation.summary: Each row represents an interest topic Facebook has associated with the participant for ad targeting purposes.

columns.Ad: Interest topic used for ad targeting.

title.nl: Facebook items die je recentelijk hebt bekeken

description.en: This table shows the Facebook posts, videos, and other items you have recently viewed.
description.nl: Deze tabel toont de Facebook-posts, video's en andere items die je recentelijk hebt bekeken.

documentation.summary: Each row represents a Facebook post, video, or other item the participant recently viewed, including the category, name, link, and date.

columns.Name: Name or title of the viewed item.
columns.Date: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the item was viewed.

title.nl: Profielen die je recentelijk hebt bezocht

description.en: This table lists the Facebook profiles you have visited most recently.
description.nl: Deze tabel toont de Facebook-profielen die je recentelijk hebt bezocht.

documentation.summary: Each row represents a Facebook profile or page the participant recently visited, including the category, name, link, and date.

columns.Name: Name or title of the visited profile or page.
columns.Link: URL of the visited profile or page.
columns.Date: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the visit occurred.

description.en: This table contains a log of changes you've made to your Facebook profile information.
description.nl: Deze tabel bevat een logboek van de wijzigingen die je in je Facebook-profielinformatie hebt aangebracht.

documentation.summary: Each row represents a change the participant made to their Facebook profile, including the title of the change and the timestamp.

columns.Title: Description of the profile change.
columns.Timestamp: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the change was made.

description.en: This table contains your responses (going, interested, declined) to Facebook events.
description.nl: Deze tabel bevat je reacties (gaat, geïnteresseerd, afgewezen) op Facebook-evenementen.

documentation.summary: Each row represents a Facebook event the participant responded to (going, interested, or declined), including the event name and start time.

columns.Name: Name of the Facebook event.
columns.Timestamp: ISO 8601 timestamp of the event start time.

title.en: Your posts and comments in groups
title.nl: Je berichten en commentaren in groepen

description.en: This table shows your posts and comments within Facebook groups.
description.nl: Deze tabel toont je berichten en commentaren in Facebook-groepen.

documentation.summary: Each row represents a post or comment the participant made in a Facebook group, including the title, post content, date, and URL.

columns.Title: Title of the group post.
columns.Date: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the post was made.

title.en: Your answers to group membership questions
title.nl: Je antwoorden op vragen voor groepslidmaatschap

description.en: This table contains the answers you provided when requesting to join Facebook groups.
description.nl: Deze tabel bevat de antwoorden die je hebt gegeven bij het aanvragen van lidmaatschap van Facebook-groepen.

documentation.summary: Each row represents a Facebook group the participant answered membership questions for when requesting to join.

description.en: This table specifically lists the comments you have made in Facebook groups.
description.nl: Deze tabel toont specifiek de commentaren die je in Facebook-groepen hebt geplaatst.

documentation.summary: Each row represents a comment the participant made in a Facebook group, including the title, comment text, group name, and timestamp.

columns.Title: Title of the post the comment was made on.
columns.Timestamp: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the comment was made.

title.en: Facebook groups you are a member of
title.nl: Facebookgroepen waar je lid van bent

description.en: This table lists the Facebook groups you are currently a member of.
description.nl: Deze tabel toont de Facebookgroepen waar je momenteel lid van bent.

documentation.summary: Each row represents a Facebook group the participant joined, including the title, group name, and the time of joining.

columns.Title: Title or description of the membership activity.
columns.Timestamp: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the participant joined.

title.en: Pages and profiles that you follow
title.nl: Pagina's en profielen die je volgt

description.en: This table displays the Facebook Pages and profiles that you actively follow.
description.nl: Deze tabel toont de Facebookpagina's en -profielen die je actief volgt.

documentation.summary: Each row represents a Facebook Page or profile the participant follows, including the title and time they started following.

columns.Title: Title of the followed Page or profile.
columns.Timestamp: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the participant started following.

description.en: This table contains a history of the Facebook Pages you have liked.
description.nl: Deze tabel bevat een overzicht van de Facebookpagina's die je leuk vindt.

documentation.summary: Each row represents a Facebook Page the participant has liked, including the page name, URL, and timestamp.

columns.Name: Name of the liked Facebook Page.
columns.URL: URL of the liked Facebook Page.
columns.Timestamp: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the page was liked.

description.en: This table contains the posts, videos, and other content you have saved on Facebook.
description.nl: Deze tabel bevat de berichten, video's en andere content die je op Facebook hebt opgeslagen.

documentation.summary: Each row represents a post, video, or other item the participant saved on Facebook, including the title and timestamp.

columns.Title: Title of the saved item.
columns.Timestamp: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the item was saved.

description.en: This table shows all the comments you have made on Facebook posts and other content.
description.nl: Deze tabel toont alle commentaren die je op Facebook-berichten en andere content hebt geplaatst.

documentation.summary: Each row represents a comment the participant made on a Facebook post or other content, including the title, comment text, and timestamp.

columns.Title: Title of the post the comment was made on.
columns.Timestamp: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the comment was made.

title.nl: Posts die je leuk vond (met titel)

description.en: This table shows the titles of posts you liked on Facebook.
description.nl: Deze tabel toont de titels van posts die je leuk vond op Facebook.

documentation.summary: Each row represents a post the participant liked or reacted to on Facebook, including the post title, reaction type, and timestamp.

columns.Title: Title of the post that was liked or reacted to.
columns.Reaction: Type of reaction (e.g. Like, Love, Haha).
columns.Timestamp: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the reaction was made.

title.nl: Dagen waarop je actief commentaren hebt geplaatst

description.en: This table indicates the days on which you made comments on Facebook.
description.nl: Deze tabel toont de dagen waarop je commentaren op Facebook hebt geplaatst.

documentation.summary: Each row represents a label-value pair indicating the days on which the participant actively commented on Facebook.

description.en: This table lists the Facebook Pages that you administer.
description.nl: Deze tabel toont de Facebookpagina's die je beheert.

documentation.summary: Each row represents a Facebook Page the participant administers, including the page name, URL, and creation timestamp.

columns.Name: Name of the Facebook Page.
columns.Timestamp: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the page was created.

description.en: This table contains your reactions to Facebook Stories.
description.nl: Deze tabel bevat je reacties op Facebook Stories.

documentation.summary: Each row represents a Facebook Story the participant reacted to, identified by its title.

columns.Title: Title of the story that was reacted to.

description.en: This table shows the posts and places you have checked into on Facebook.
description.nl: Deze tabel toont de berichten en plaatsen waar je op Facebook hebt ingecheckt.

documentation.summary: Each row represents a post or check-in the participant made on Facebook, including the title and timestamp.

columns.Title: Title of the post or check-in.
columns.Timestamp: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the post or check-in was made.

description.en: This table shows your likes and reactions to posts and other content on Facebook.
description.nl: Deze tabel toont je likes en reacties op berichten en andere content op Facebook.

documentation.summary: Each row represents a like or reaction the participant gave on Facebook, including the reaction type, name, URL, and timestamp.

columns.Reaction: Type of reaction (e.g. Like, Love, Haha).
columns.Name: Name of the content that was reacted to.
columns.URL: URL of the content that was reacted to.
columns.Timestamp: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the reaction was made.

description.en: This table shows the actions you've taken to customise what content you see more or less of on Facebook.
description.nl: Deze tabel toont de acties die je hebt ondernomen om aan te passen welke content je meer of minder ziet op Facebook.

documentation.summary: Each row represents an action the participant took to customise their Facebook feed (show more or show less of certain content), including the action type, content affected, and date.

columns.Action: Feed control action taken (e.g. Show more, Show less).
columns.Content: Content or topic the action was applied to.
columns.Date: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the action was taken.
